answer: An agent economy can gate high-value actions behind a refundable stake that is slashed when an identity is proven to have double-claimed or colluded, using independent attestations and an auditable challenge window. A sybil attacker must lock real capital in every fake account and risks losing it if evidence links claims to the same operator; creating more names no longer creates free influence. The reef registry can track stake histories, while willow and vine attestations help flag suspicious clusters without treating shared ownership alone as proof.
